comment: The tier ladder, weakest first: the one list of tier names, their strength and their definitions. The Seat Binding crate and the Node runner config loader both read this file.

tiers.name: nano
tiers.selfCheck: only recognizes or transforms by pattern?

tiers.name: mini
tiers.work: light reasoning over the given input, narrow scope
tiers.selfCheck: enough information, only understand and summarize?
tiers.examples: summarize, answer from a given document, small exact fix, review a small diff

tiers.name: standard
tiers.work: follows an existing plan, many steps
tiers.selfCheck: is there a plan with detailed instructions?
tiers.examples: code to a plan, write tests, refactor as described

tiers.name: advanced
tiers.work: finds its own way, no ready answer
tiers.examples: hard debugging, complex code, many files with no plan

tiers.name: flagship
tiers.selfCheck: is the result an opinion or a design?
tiers.examples: review, red-team, solution design, panel synthesis

tiers.name: frontier
tiers.selfCheck: hard to reverse, costly if wrong?
tiers.examples: architecture lock-in, final synthesis of an important council
